description:
FILED s407 (fable-answers-s406.md §5.3).  `pl-__SUB__` returns (lambda (&rest)
nil): `my $f = sub { $_[0] <= 1 ? 1 : $_[0] * __SUB__->($_[0]-1) }; print $f->(5)`
prints 0 (perl 120).  Named subs are rewritten to \&name at parse time and are
right (t122 in signatures.t); only the anon path reaches the stub.  Documented
PARTIAL in not-supported.md, but the s329 boundary says a missing case whose
VALUE the program consumes DIES — it must not hand back a lambda.
SHAPE: the stub dies "PCL: __SUB__ inside an anonymous sub is not supported
(not-supported.md)"; not-supported.md entry updated (PARTIAL -> the die);
measure t/op/current_sub.t (the one companion file that reaches it — rows
before/after, and whether the die is inside its evals) and perl-tests/sub.t
(already inline-skipped, unaffected).  A real implementation is E5-adjacent
(a per-closure self binding changes closure shape) — not this task.
BAR: gate row (dies, message), companion row for current_sub.t spliced with
cause, sweep unaffected (runtime change -> run it anyway, cl/** row).


DONE s408 (Opus 5).  pl-__SUB__ dies naming itself instead of returning a no-op
lambda.  The lambda's value flowed straight into the program's arithmetic --
`sub { $_[0] <= 1 ? 1 : $_[0] * __SUB__->($_[0]-1) }` printed 0 where perl
prints 120 -- which is exactly the rule-12 boundary case (s329): an effect-only
missing case may announce and continue, one whose VALUE the program consumes
may not.

MEASURED: gate 149/5439 (three new rows in misc-fixes-02.t -- the die, the
absence of the 0, and the NAMED-sub inverse still returning 120).  op/current_sub.t
UNCHANGED (0/0 XDIFF, same signature): it never reached the stub, dying earlier
on an arity mismatch, so no companion splice was needed.  Full sweep after the
runtime change: GATE clean, 0 new / 0 fixed, TOTAL 18513 = baseline.
not-supported.md updated (PARTIAL heading -> "anon subs DIE", with the wrong
number it used to produce).


COST FOUND s409 (Fable review): op/sub.t 51/14 -> 25/6 -- the die at op/sub.t:214 aborts the file (26 rows).  s408 re-ran only op/current_sub.t after this commit.  Snapshot row edited; the IMPLEMENTATION is task #378 (self-reference rewrite), scheduled in the next Opus session.
subject: anon-sub `__SUB__` returns a NO-OP lambda (value flows onward) — the runtime stub must DIE perl-shaped (rule 12 / s329 boundary)
